system.description:
Choose one of the following effects: [Check: Opposed (Accuracy vs Resistance) / Effect: Remove all Combat Statuses or [Check: Basic (Accuracy vs. Disable Difficulty) / Effect: Remove one Prop with the [Magical] tag.]

(Fate 1): This skill's timing changes to [Timing: Setup].

A powerful disenchantment spell that negates various enchantment spells applied to the target. It is also possible to apply this to stop magic devices.
